cases.name: required_config_missing_then_retry
cases.detail: Failed at Config; real Addressables missing key; entry untouched; repaired test alias; retry ran with a fresh context; stop left zero leases/requests.

cases.name: stop_while_starting_then_restart
cases.detail: Stop canceled startup at Entry while a real config lease was held; exit ran once; retry ran with a fresh context; zero leases/requests after both stops.

cases.name: failed_release_then_retry_stop
cases.detail: CleanupFailed held the original context and one lease; start blocked; second Stop released the exact same Addressables handle once and reset lease/request counts.
